findings.text: _CORRECTION_WRITE duplicates the StandardNameSourceRetry event creation owned by imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_source_bindings.py:2435 rather than extending it, so the done_when's clause that the correction be appended through the repository's retry-receipt writer is unmet and a future change to the label's required attributes would leave these 20 records unchecked.

the readback assertion original_attempts != attempts compares a value the write copied from the same source under a guard that requires the original to equal it, so the two sides move together and the assertion cannot fail on any regression of this change; the attempts < cap and corrected_targets == 1 checks are guaranteed the same way, leaving only the 20/20 counts independent.

the 'Originals unchanged in reason and timestamp' and 'Sources written 0' rows rest on a heredoc measurement recorded only in verify-intact.log, not on a phase of the committed runner (select, originals, negative, apply, readback), so the fragment's strongest non-mutation claim cannot be reproduced from the landed artefact; I reproduced it independently and it holds.
